PRUNING SCHEDULE
Trees planted within last 10 years:
pruned every 3 to 5 years .
Tree planted more than 10 years
ago: pruned once every 10 years .
Follow along where we are
working on our Pruning Work Map
on our website .
INVASIVE SPECIES
We treat 10,000 trees to save
them from the emerald ash
borer . When the spongy moth
population spikes, we will
take steps to help fight back.
Whatever the invasive pest
may be, we remain committed
to protecting our shared urban
forest .
